We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product. Multiplying the first row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}Ha=[\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ -3 & 6\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}7 \\ 3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}4\cdot 7+2\cdot 3 \\ ∗\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}34 \\ ∗\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Multiplying the second row, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}Ha=[\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ -3 & 6\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}7 \\ 3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}34 \\ -3\cdot 7+6\cdot 3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}34 \\ -3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 
$Ha=[\begin{aligned}34 \\ -3\end{aligned}].$
